project.description: A Flutter module implementing the Da Liu Ren (大六壬) divination system, part of the larger xuan (玄学) Chinese metaphysics project. Built with clean architecture using Provider, Drift (SQLite), and json_serializable.

layers.description: Markdown documentation, architecture notes, AI-generated refactor reports, and the historical READ_ME_NOTICE on bureau-handling quirks.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Flutter/Dart project manifests and tooling configuration — pubspec.yaml, analysis_options.yaml, build.yaml.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and ARCHITECTURE doc to grasp the scope: a Flutter module implementing the Da Liu Ren (大六壬) divination system as part of the larger xuan (玄学) project. The CLAUDE.md adds context on the domain-specific bureau (局) rules.

tour.title: Project Manifest & Tooling
tour.description: pubspec.yaml declares this as a Flutter module (not a standalone app) and lists the key dependencies: Provider (state), Drift (SQLite ORM), fpdart (functional patterns), json_serializable, and tyme (lunar calendar). build.yaml drives code generation.
tour.languageLesson: Flutter modules embed inside host apps via Add-to-App. The `module:` section in pubspec.yaml sets the Android package and iOS bundle identifier used during embedding.

tour.title: Module Entry & Routing
tour.description: lib/navigator.dart is the host's entry into this module — it registers the /daliuren and /daliuren/dev routes. From here the host can navigate into the divination UI or the developer debug page.

tour.title: Dependency Injection
tour.description: lib/di/dependency_injection.dart wires the layered architecture together using Provider. This is the place to follow when you want to see how a request flows from the UI all the way down to SQLite and back.

tour.title: Domain Layer — Entities & Enums
tour.description: Pure-Dart domain models with no Flutter or storage dependencies. Entities (LiuRenPanModel, RawPanInfoModel, ShenShaEntity hierarchy) and typed enums (PanType, GuiRenType, ZeiKePatternType) define the vocabulary of the divination engine.

tour.title: Domain Layer — Repository Contracts
tour.description: Abstract contracts describing what the data layer must provide. DaLiuRenRepository is the single contract for the entire divination dataset; its implementation lives in lib/data/.

tour.title: Domain Layer — Calculators
tour.description: The heart of the divination engine. BaseCalculator is the abstract template; concrete calculators handle 天地盘 (TianDiPan), 四课 (FourClass), 三传 (ThreeChuan), 贵人 (GuiRen), and lunar conversions. ThreeChuan strategies branch by bureau (九宗门).
tour.languageLesson: Strategy pattern in Dart: an abstract ThreeChuanStrategy class declares the interface, and the calculator picks the right concrete strategy per bureau at runtime. This mirrors the 先孟仲法 → 涉害法 fallback documented in READ_ME_NOTICE.

tour.title: Domain Layer — Composite Services
tour.description: Higher-level services orchestrate the calculators end-to-end. DaLiuRenCalculationService is the top-level entry point; YuDingKetiMatchService matches a computed panel against the 御定大六壬 catalog of named ketis (课体).

tour.title: Domain Layer — Use Cases
tour.description: Single-purpose application use cases provide a uniform call(Params) → Future<Either<Failure, Result>> signature (fpdart). They are what viewmodels invoke; they translate UI intents into calls against repositories and services.
tour.languageLesson: fpdart's Either<L, R> replaces exceptions for expected failure modes. The base use case fixes the contract so every operation returns a Future<Either<Failure, Result>> — the viewmodel can pattern-match without try/catch.

tour.title: Data Layer — Local Drift Database
tour.description: Drift wires Dart classes to SQLite. drift_database.dart bundles tables (preset_pans, ju_mappings, yu_ding_entries, db_initialization_flags), DAOs (liuren_dao), and JSON↔column converters (four_class, three_chuan, set/map converters).
tour.languageLesson: Drift uses build_runner code generation: each Table subclass becomes a Dart-typed query interface. Custom TypeConverter<T, S> classes serialize complex domain types to TEXT columns.

tour.title: Data Layer — Models & Repository Implementation
tour.description: Drift-friendly data models mirror the domain entities for storage. DaLiuRenRepositoryImpl orchestrates local + remote data sources to satisfy the domain-layer contract.

tour.title: Presentation Layer — MVVM Refactor
tour.description: The new MVVM stack: BaseViewModel provides loading/error plumbing, DaLiuRenViewModel manages the divination screen state, and DaLiuRenView consumes it via Provider. Widget subdirectories split the UI into reusable pieces.
tour.languageLesson: Provider exposes a ChangeNotifier (the viewmodel) to descendant widgets. notifyListeners() in the viewmodel triggers a rebuild of widgets that called context.watch<T>() or Consumer<T>.

tour.title: Legacy Surfaces & Refactor History
tour.description: lib/pages/my_home_page.dart is the ~3000-line pre-refactor home page being migrated piecewise to MVVM. The lib/model/ directory holds older JSON-serializable models still wired into parts of the calculation pipeline. docs/claude/ captures the AI-generated refactor plan and review.

tour.title: Domain Lore — Bureau Quirks
tour.description: READ_ME_NOTICE documents a subtle calculation rule: bureau (局) order produces different effects, and specific JiaZi day-bureau combinations trigger the 先孟仲法 / 涉害法 fallback. This is essential context for anyone touching the three-transmissions calculator.
